review_scope: Independent adversarial pre-implementation contract review; no other reviewer reports used and no production edits.

assessment: Closed control schemas and duplicate-free bounded private journal explicitly fail closed; durable RESERVED/CONNECTING distinguish no-attempt from uncertain backend ownership.

SO_PEERCRED, process start identity, recorded parent liveness, nonce, proxy generation and monotone connection generation bind admission and receipt; same-UID different-process replay is a required runtime subcase.

Success additionally requires staged result, complete legal COMMIT and Ready(I), normal Terminate, no sticky failure, deadline/liveness checks, closed transport and independently observed exact backend absence. Cleanup alone cannot authorize output.

Exact SQL and execution-level protocol cursor fence require one complete Q or unnamed P/B/optional D/E0/S cycle; Parse admission, repeated Bind/Execute, incomplete Sync, pipelines and other raw control paths cannot advance success. Existing ParserGate remains mandatory.

Baseline Store has a read-only repeatable-read snapshot and complete requested-ID history scan, CLI already validates private requestId, and Java supplies nonce-bound bridge response checks with a 20s cap. Proposed changes explicitly preserve this data contract while adding the cleanup fence.

Runner binds all six exact-root approvals, pinned inputs, exact elaborated types/axioms, inherited anchors and two isolated builds; it does not claim runtime correspondence or reprove the active 309 anchors.
delta_review: Reverified every one of 137 pinned files and exact canonical R2 root; no mismatches. Rechecked unchanged 28-claim/type/model source inventory.
Managed retrieval virtualenv and pinned psycopg/libpq dependency verification explicitly replace the unsuitable system proxy interpreter; sealed parser helper remains separately pinned.

Ordinary canonical SELECT 1 readiness probe precedes first observer reservation; bounded serialized retry does not create observer uncertainty merely because bootstrap role/database is not yet present. This probe does not masquerade as cleanup evidence.

Single event-loop owner serializes complete-state non-awaiting journal mutations and rejects wrong-thread updates; worker thread supplies immutable observations only. Persistence failure retains both reservations and disables success/replacement. CC22 explicitly exercises interleaving and crash cuts.
CC01 includes actual interpreter/dependency identity and empty-cluster bootstrap instrumentation. No production implementation or runtime claim is introduced by this delta.

limitations: Runtime lease/control implementation is absent and all 33 runtime cases remain unexecuted; approval is permission to implement the frozen contract, not a runtime acceptance certificate.
No independent clean Lean build was run during this review; two matching isolated builds remain required after all six approvals. Static source/type/claim inventory validation passed.

The Lean model guards trusted observations and abstracts time, parent liveness, journal/fsync, protocol execution and observer mechanics. Its single Lease occupancy theorem is not a proof that production contains only one lease; the durable Nat invariant is not proof of database byte invariance. Runtime binding remains required.

Pre-key context or observer crashes may retain UNKNOWN/DEGRADED indefinitely. Ordinary disconnected backend tails or external sessions may exhaust PostgreSQL slots. These are explicitly disclosed fail-closed availability limitations, not blockers to this implementation contract.

Full permitted history/quota success, parser routing, logging privacy, crash barriers and no stale publication require actual isolated integration evidence; target 4-vCPU/8-GiB acceptance remains separate.
commercial_scope: Approve only the read-only validationContext cleanup contract. No warm JVM, outcome cache, mutation/receipt/CAS change, direct database route, elevated observer privilege, PID-only signal, aggregate backend capacity guarantee, automatic pre-key recovery guarantee, universal implementation refinement, or deployment performance claim is approved.
